messages.content: pernicious slave Forsooth took on him as a conjurer And gazing in mine eyes feeling my pulse And with no face as twere outfacing me Cries out I was possessd Then altogether They fell upon me bound me bore me thence And in a dark and dankish vault at home There left me and my man both bound together Till gnawing with my teeth my bonds in sunder I gaind my freedom and immediately Ran hither to your Grace whom I besee
